title: Hezekiah Organizes the Priests

questions.question: What did the people do after the Passover?
options: Went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pieces the pillars and cut down the Asherim
questions.correctAnswer: Went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pieces the pillars and cut down the Asherim
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:1 (ESV): "...all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke in pieces the pillars and cut down the Asherim..."

questions.question: What divisions did Hezekiah organize?
options: The divisions of the priests and of the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: The divisions of the priests and of the Levites
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:2 (ESV): "And Hezekiah appointed the divisions of the priests and of the Levites..."

questions.question: What contribution did the king appoint?
options: From his own possessions for the burnt offerings
questions.correctAnswer: From his own possessions for the burnt offerings
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:3 (ESV): "The contribution of the king from his own possessions was for the burnt offerings..."

questions.question: What did he command the people to give?
options: The portion due to the priests and the Levites
questions.correctAnswer: The portion due to the priests and the Levites
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:4 (ESV): "...he commanded the people... to give the portion due to the priests and the Levites..."

questions.question: How much did the people bring in?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:5 (ESV): "...and they brought in abundantly the tithe of everything."

questions.question: When did they begin and finish piling up the heaps?
options: Began in the third month and finished in the seventh month
questions.correctAnswer: Began in the third month and finished in the seventh month
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:7 (ESV): "In the third month they began to pile up the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month."

questions.question: What did Hezekiah and the princes do when they saw the heaps?
options: They blessed the LORD and his people Israel
questions.correctAnswer: They blessed the LORD and his people Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:8 (ESV): "...they blessed the LORD and his people Israel."

questions.question: Who was the chief priest at this time?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:10 (ESV): "And Azariah the chief priest... answered him..."

questions.question: What chambers did Hezekiah prepare?
options: Chambers in the house of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Chambers in the house of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:11 (ESV): "Then Hezekiah commanded them to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD..."

questions.question: How did Hezekiah do his work?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:21 (ESV): "...he did with all his heart, and prospered."

questions.question: Who was over the freewill offerings of God?
options: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite
questions.correctAnswer: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:14 (ESV): "And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite... was over the freewill offerings of God..."

questions.question: From what age were male Levites enrolled?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:16 (ESV): "...every male from three years old and upward..."

questions.question: From what age were priests enrolled by their genealogy?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:17 (ESV): "...The priests... and the Levites from twenty years old and upward..."

questions.question: Who was ruler and who was second over the contribution?
options: Conaniah was ruler and Shimei his brother was second
questions.correctAnswer: Conaniah was ruler and Shimei his brother was second
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:12 (ESV): "...Conaniah the Levite was ruler and Shimei his brother was second."

questions.question: What characterizes Hezekiah's work throughout all Judah?
options: He did what was good and right and faithful before the LORD his God
questions.correctAnswer: He did what was good and right and faithful before the LORD his God
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 31:20 (ESV): "Thus Hezekiah did throughout all Judah, and he did what was good and right and faithful before the LORD his God."

key_verse_text: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, in accordance with the law and the commandments, seeking his God, he did with all his heart, and prospered.
